t: Arevo raises €7.3M to scale bio-based fertiliser that boosts soy yields and slashes nitrogen emissions
s: October 30, 2025 - Swedish agtech firm Arevo has secured €7.3 million to expand its bio-based fertiliser production, which uses arginine to enhance root development and reduce nitrogen leaching, thereby improving yields and cutting emissions. Planning to enter Brazil's soy market by 2027, Arevo's seed coating, Arevo Booster, has shown a yield boost of 4-6% per hectare in field trials across 16 countries, offering a sustainable alternative to synthetic fertilisers.
